notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
New update ! 

[h1]Deathrun mode :[/h1]

Discover Deathrun mode in which humans must place traps along a level that insects must avoid and try to finish the course. Humans can place automatic traps or activatable ones in a horror ambiance.

[h1]Bug correction[/h1]

- Improved performance (improved 3d environment).
- Correction of mouse angle of view.
- Updated graphics engine and Nvidia physx addon.
- Particles correction when human uses spray.

We added a new steam topic in which players can report bugs.

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
[h1]New ![/h1]

- New map with a [b]new mod[/b] (in this new mod, you'll have to eat all cakes before the end of the game). 
- 2 sections (Normal maps / Special maps).
- Now you can know players' statut by pressing tab during game.

[h1]Bug correction[/h1]

- Improved performance (click on  "Performance" in the video settings instead of "Quality"). 
[b]- Frame rate correction.[/b]
- "V-sync" correction.
- Ranking hud adjustement.
- Victory HUD correction.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
New update !

Some bugs fixed :
- Mouse Trap Collision.
- Spawn issue during character selection.

Graphics Improvement :
- Lighting correction in the office map.

Gameplay Adjustment :
- Adjustment of the flamethrower (to kill faster)

The "single player mode" become the "Training Mode" !
